author: Unity
description:
A new edition of our ultimate 2D game art, animation, and lighting guide is out! 

All of the workflows covered in the guide are now up to date with Unity 6.3 LTS, including new possibilities like mixing 3D and 2D. Created in collaboration with a professional 2D game artist and developer, and Unity 2D engineers, this guide teaches techniques for how to use the latest and greatest features in Unity. Create a 2D world with the rich detail, lighting, visual effects, and polish you need. You’ll also get optimization tips to make sure you can take your 2D worlds to any platform.

Download the Unity 6.3 LTS 2D e-book here: https://on.unity.com/2D_GameEbook

Highlights from this edition include: 

New Render 3D elements as 2D
Sprite editor options
2D art preparation
Environment design with 2D Tilemap
2D skeletal animation
2D physics fundamentals
2D light and shadow techniques
2D optimization tips
 
Don’t wait to get this great reference to boost your professional 2D game development.
title: New e-book: 2D game art, animation, and lighting for Unity 6.3 LTS
